# CRM Laws & Compliance Requirements

| Jurisdiction | Requirement relevant to CRM operations |
| --- | --- |
| Mainland China | PIPL requires a lawful basis, purpose limitation and appropriate protection for customer and contact data. Automated marketing should offer a non-personalised option or a convenient refusal mechanism. |
| Mainland China | Network data rules require safeguards such as encryption, backup, access control and security authentication. |
| Mainland China | Cross-border transfers need a separate assessment. Data that contains personal information cannot be treated as ordinary enterprise data, even when used for international trade. |
| European Union | GDPR requires a lawful basis, transparency, data-subject rights, retention controls and safeguards for profiling or significant automated decisions. |
| United States | CAN-SPAM requires accurate sender information, a physical postal address and a clear, working opt-out mechanism for commercial email. AI-generated voice outreach may also trigger TCPA requirements. |
| Singapore and ASEAN | PDPA and the Do Not Call Registry affect collection, use, disclosure and marketing outreach. ASEAN AI guidance supports a common responsible-AI baseline but does not replace national laws. |
| Product control | Maintain consent/lawful-basis tags, source records, suppression lists, regional rules, export logs, retention settings and human approval for high-risk actions. |
